qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/ Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET/ GATE or National level examinations by Central Govt. Depts. Desirable: M.Tech/ M.E. in Civil/ Mechanical/ Mining/ Applied Mechanics or B.Tech with valid GATE or high CGPA from NIRF ranked institute. Strongly desired: Knowledge in Solid Mechanics, stress-strain analysis, fracture mechanics, structural health monitoring, FEM simulations.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur is 03-09-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in the IIT Kharagpur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE. Desirable qualifications include M.Tech/M.E. or B.Tech with valid GATE.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Research Fellow position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable skills for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Strongly desired skills include knowledge in Solid Mechanics, stress-strain analysis, fracture mechanics, structural health monitoring, and FEM simulations.
